legend: The Gossip Club 2880 was founded and its $$$n$$$ members are furious. So furious that each of them is going to try to cancel ("funar") one person of the club, chosen at random. They are so crazy that they can even cancel themselves.

Each of the $$$n$$$ members chooses whom to cancel among the $$$n$$$ members, including themselves, with the same probability for each one. Each cancel attempt has a $$$p\%$$$ probability of being effective, regardless of what happens with the others. A person ends up cancelled ("funado") if at least one cancel attempt against them is effective. If there are several cancel attempts against a person, it is more likely that they end up cancelled.
What is the probability that exactly $$$k$$$ people end up cancelled?
input: The first line contains an integer $$$T$$$, the number of test cases.
Each of the following $$$T$$$ lines contains three integers $$$n$$$, $$$k$$$ and $$$p$$$.
The sum of $$$n$$$ over all cases is at most $$$10^5$$$.
output: For each case, the probability is an irreducible fraction $$$a/b$$$. Print on one line $$$a \cdot b^{-1} \bmod (998244353)$$$, where $$$b^{-1}$$$ is the integer such that $$$b \cdot b^{-1} \equiv 1 \pmod{998244353}$$$. It can be shown that it always exists.

legend.ai: Gossip Club 2880 成立了，其 $$$n$$$ 名成员都怒不可遏。愤怒至极的他们决定每人随机选择俱乐部中的一个人来取消(“funar”)。他们甚至疯狂到会取消自己。
$$$n$$$ 名成员中的每个人都会从 $$$n$$$ 名成员中(包括自己)等概率地选择一人进行“封杀”。每次封杀尝试都有 $$$p\%$$$ 的概率生效，且与其他尝试的结果无关。若针对某人的至少一次封杀尝试生效，则该人最终会被“封杀”(“funado”)。针对同一人的封杀尝试越多，其最终被封杀的概率就越大。
恰好有 $$$k$$$ 个人最终被取消的概率是多少？

input.ai: 第一行包含一个整数 $$$T$$$，表示测试用例的数量。
所有测试用例中 $$$n$$$ 的总和不超过 $$$10^5$$$。

output.ai: 对于每种情况，概率都是一个最简分数 $$$a/b$$$。请在一行中输出 $$$a \cdot b^{-1} \bmod (998244353)$$$，其中 $$$b^{-1}$$$ 是满足 $$$b \cdot b^{-1} \equiv 1 \pmod{998244353}$$$ 的整数。可以证明，这样的整数总是存在。
